name: Landing: headline and three principles

planSteps.description: Navigate to `/` on the target preview origin.
The page shows the brand `Mosaic` and the text `Information changes.`
The page shows the button or link `Sign in to your workspace`.
The page shows the three feature headings `Cited to the exact words`, `Nothing moves until you approve` and `Undo that respects later work`.

name: Landing: How it works section

planSteps.description: Navigate to `/` on the target preview origin.
Click the navigation link `How it works`.
The heading `From revised brief to settled work` is visible.
The four steps `Bring a source`, `Review the change`, `Apply with care` and `Keep the history` are visible, in that order.

name: Sign-in page from the landing page

planSteps.description: Navigate to `/` on the target preview origin.
Click the header link named exactly `Sign in`.
The URL path is `/login`.
The heading `Welcome back.` is visible, with an `Email` field, a `Password` field and a `Sign in` button.
There is no option to create an account or register.

name: Signed-out visitor cannot open the workspace

planSteps.description: Navigate to `/app` on the target preview origin without signing in.
The browser ends on the `/login` path.
The heading `Welcome back.` is visible and no task board, workspace selector or `Sign out` button is shown.

name: Judge lobby without a link shows no seats

planSteps.description: Navigate to `/lobby` on the target preview origin, with no `#` fragment.
The heading `Choose a seat` is visible.
The message `This lobby link is invalid or has expired.` is visible.
No seat buttons (for example `Seat 1`) are shown.

name: Access link page without a token is refused

planSteps.description: Navigate to `/access` on the target preview origin, with no `#` fragment.
The heading `Link not accepted` is visible.
The message `This access link is invalid or has expired.` is visible.
No task board or `Sign out` button is shown.

name: Landing: review preview shows a cited change

planSteps.description: Navigate to `/` on the target preview origin.
The preview card shows `Launch brief` and `Version 2`.
It shows the old line `Launch on 22 October.` and the new line `Launch on 29 October, after the security review.`
It shows the proposals `Due date Oct 22 → Oct 29` and `Book security review`, each with a quoted passage, and the receipt line `1 change applied · receipt saved · undo available`.

name: Landing: See how it works jumps to the steps

planSteps.description: Navigate to `/` on the target preview origin.
Click the button `See how it works`.
The URL ends with `#how`.
The heading `From revised brief to settled work` is visible.

name: Landing footer link opens sign-in

planSteps.description: Navigate to `/` on the target preview origin.
Scroll to the footer and click `Sign in to Mosaic`.
The URL path is `/login` and the heading `Welcome back.` is visible.

name: Sign-in rejects unknown credentials

planSteps.description: Navigate to `/login` on the target preview origin.
Enter `nobody@example.test` in the `Email` field and `not-a-real-password-123` in the `Password` field.
Click the `Sign in` button.
The message `Email or password is incorrect.` is visible.
The URL path is still `/login` and no `Sign out` button is shown.

name: Signed-out deep links redirect to sign-in

planSteps.description: Navigate to `/app/sources` on the target preview origin without signing in.
The browser ends on the `/login` path with the heading `Welcome back.`
Navigate to `/app/changes`.
The browser ends on the `/login` path.
Navigate to `/app/activity`.
The browser ends on the `/login` path.

name: Judge lobby rejects a made-up link

planSteps.description: Navigate to `/lobby#not-a-real-link` on the target preview origin.
The heading `Choose a seat` is visible.
The message `This lobby link is invalid or has expired.` is visible.
No seat buttons (for example `Seat 1`) are shown.

name: Access page rejects a made-up token and hides it

planSteps.description: Navigate to `/access#not-a-real-link` on the target preview origin.
The heading `Link not accepted` and the message `This access link is invalid or has expired.` are visible.
The address bar no longer contains `not-a-real-link`.
No task board or `Sign out` button is shown.

name: Unknown pages return not found

planSteps.description: Navigate to `/no-such-page` on the target preview origin.
The text `404` and `This page could not be found.` are visible.
No workspace content or `Sign out` button is shown.

name: Lobby removes the link from the address bar

planSteps.description: Navigate to `/lobby#not-a-real-link` on the target preview origin.
Wait until the lobby page has finished loading and shows its message.
The heading `Choose a seat` is visible.
The browser address bar URL does not contain `not-a-real-link` and has no `#` fragment; the private link has been removed from the address bar.

name: Signed in: sign in opens the board and sign out ends the session

planSteps.description: Navigate to `/login` on the target preview origin and sign in with the project's configured test login (email and password).
The heading `A clear view of what’s next.` is visible and a `Sign out` button is shown.
Click `Sign out`.
The landing page is shown with the header link `Sign in`, and no `Sign out` button is visible.
Navigate to `/app`.
The browser is redirected to `/login` with the heading `Welcome back.`; no board is shown.

name: Signed in: board shows the seeded tasks in their columns

planSteps.description: Navigate to `/login` on the target preview origin and sign in with the project's configured test login (email and password).
In the `Active workspace` dropdown at the top left, select the workspace named exactly `App smoke · editable`.
The columns `To do`, `In progress` and `Done` are visible.
`Draft the release notes` and `Send the press kit` are in `To do`, `Book the launch venue` is in `In progress`, and `Choose the launch date` is in `Done`.

name: Signed in: Find a task filters the board

planSteps.description: Navigate to `/login` on the target preview origin and sign in with the project's configured test login (email and password).
In the `Active workspace` dropdown at the top left, select the workspace named exactly `App smoke · read-only`.
Type `venue` into the `Find a task` field.
`Book the launch venue` is visible.
`Draft the release notes`, `Send the press kit` and `Choose the launch date` are no longer visible.

name: Signed in: task detail shows fields and history

planSteps.description: Navigate to `/login` on the target preview origin and sign in with the project's configured test login (email and password).
In the `Active workspace` dropdown at the top left, select the workspace named exactly `App smoke · read-only`.
Click the task title link `Draft the release notes` on the board (the title text itself, which is a link).
A dialog titled `Draft the release notes` opens, showing `Status`, `Assignee` and `Due date`.
Its `History` section shows `App smoke owner` and `created this task`.
Close the dialog with the `×` button.
The board is visible again.

name: Signed in: a new task persists after a refresh

planSteps.description: Navigate to `/login` on the target preview origin and sign in with the project's configured test login (email and password).
In the `Active workspace` dropdown at the top left, select the workspace named exactly `App smoke · editable`.

Pick a random six-digit number N. Click `Add task`, enter the title `Smoke task N` (for example `Smoke task 482913`) in `Task title`, leave the other fields as they are, and click `Create task`. Remember the exact title you typed.
A task with exactly that title appears in the `To do` column.
Reload the page.
The task with exactly that title is still in the `To do` column.

name: Signed in: changing a task's status persists and is recorded

planSteps.description: Navigate to `/login` on the target preview origin and sign in with the project's configured test login (email and password).
In the `Active workspace` dropdown at the top left, select the workspace named exactly `App smoke · editable`.
Pick a random six-digit number N. Click `Add task`, enter the title `Status check N` in `Task title`, click `Create task`, and remember the exact title.
Reload the page and wait for the board to load.
Click the title link of the task with that exact title (the title text itself, which is a link) to open its dialog.
Change `Status` to `In progress` and click `Save changes`.
The task appears in the `In progress` column.
Reload the page, then open the same task again by clicking its title link.
Its `Status` is `In progress` and its `History` shows an entry by `App smoke tester` for the status change.

name: Signed in: sources list shows the brief and its revisions

planSteps.description: Navigate to `/login` on the target preview origin and sign in with the project's configured test login (email and password).
In the `Active workspace` dropdown at the top left, select the workspace named exactly `App smoke · read-only`.
Click `Sources` in the left navigation.
The heading `Sources` is visible and the source `App smoke brief` is listed with `2 revisions`.

name: Signed in: source comparison shows what changed

planSteps.description: Navigate to `/login` on the target preview origin and sign in with the project's configured test login (email and password).
In the `Active workspace` dropdown at the top left, select the workspace named exactly `App smoke · read-only`.
Click `Sources`, then click `App smoke brief`.
The `Source revision` selector shows `Version 2 · explicit revision`.
The text `Launch on 9 November 2026` and `Record a short product video.` is shown for version 2.
`What changed in the source` shows the version 1 line containing `Launch on 2 November 2026` next to the version 2 line.

name: Signed in: a passage link opens the exact source text

planSteps.description: Navigate to `/login` on the target preview origin and sign in with the project's configured test login (email and password).
In the `Active workspace` dropdown at the top left, select the workspace named exactly `App smoke · read-only`.
Click `Sources`, then `App smoke brief`.
Under `Selected revision · version 2`, click `Open passage · v2`.
The version 2 text containing `Record a short product video.` is shown with that passage highlighted or focused.

name: Signed in: adding a source revision creates a new version

planSteps.description: Navigate to `/login` on the target preview origin and sign in with the project's configured test login (email and password).
In the `Active workspace` dropdown at the top left, select the workspace named exactly `App smoke · editable`.
Click `Sources`, then `App smoke brief`.
Click `Add revision`. In `Revised source` enter `FICTIONAL TEST BRIEF. Launch on 9 November 2026. Smoke revision <current date and time to the second>.` and remember it.
Click `Save revision`.
The `Source revision` selector now shows a version number higher than 2 as selected, and the page shows the exact text you entered.

name: Signed in: fixture proposal shows cited changes

planSteps.description: Navigate to `/login` on the target preview origin and sign in with the project's configured test login (email and password).
In the `Active workspace` dropdown at the top left, select the workspace named exactly `App smoke · read-only`.
Click `Changes` in the left navigation, then click `Source proposal · e7d1657c`.
The heading `Consider the change.` and the label `Deterministic test fixture · not live AI` are visible.
An `Update dueDate` item for `Draft the release notes` shows current value `2026-11-02` and proposed value `2026-11-06`, quoting `Draft the release notes by 6 November 2026.`
A `Create task` item `Record a short product video` quotes `Record a short product video.`
`Needs your decision` asks `Who records the product video?` and `What stays as it is` lists `Choose the launch date stays done.`

name: Signed in: a viewer cannot apply a proposal

planSteps.description: Navigate to `/login` on the target preview origin and sign in with the project's configured test login (email and password).
In the `Active workspace` dropdown at the top left, select the workspace named exactly `App smoke · read-only`.
Click `Changes`, then `Source proposal · e7d1657c`.
Both proposal checkboxes are disabled.
There is no `Apply selected changes` button on the page.

name: Signed in: a viewer's board has no editing controls

planSteps.description: Navigate to `/login` on the target preview origin and sign in with the project's configured test login (email and password).
In the `Active workspace` dropdown at the top left, select the workspace named exactly `App smoke · read-only`.
The board shows `Draft the release notes`.
There is no `Add task` button and no `Bring a source` button.
In the `Active workspace` dropdown at the top left, select the workspace named exactly `App smoke · editable`.
In this workspace the `Add task` and `Bring a source` buttons are visible.

name: Signed in: activity lists recorded changes

planSteps.description: Navigate to `/login` on the target preview origin and sign in with the project's configured test login (email and password).
In the `Active workspace` dropdown at the top left, select the workspace named exactly `App smoke · read-only`.
Click `Activity` in the left navigation.
The heading `Activity` and a `Search recent activity` field are visible.
At least one entry shows `App smoke owner` with `recorded change` and an `Inspect immutable history` control. Do not click `Preview safe undo`.

name: Signed in: members page shows roles

planSteps.description: Navigate to `/login` on the target preview origin and sign in with the project's configured test login (email and password).
In the `Active workspace` dropdown at the top left, select the workspace named exactly `App smoke · editable`.
Click `Members` in the left navigation.
The heading `Members` is visible, listing `App smoke owner` as `owner` and `App smoke tester` as `editor`.

name: Signed in: preview never runs live AI

planSteps.description: Navigate to `/login` on the target preview origin and sign in with the project's configured test login (email and password).
In the `Active workspace` dropdown at the top left, select the workspace named exactly `App smoke · editable`.
Click `Sources`, then `App smoke brief`.
The message `Live Gemini analysis is unavailable. Your source is saved. Fixture output is never substituted for a live proposal.` is visible.
No new proposal is created: do not click `Analyze this revision ↗`.
